text:
Priya (Onboarding Lead): Hi team — kicking off Novus Retail onboarding. Goal: go-live pilot in 30 days, hand off to Success Ops at day 45. Need stakeholders, key success criteria, and any immediate risks. Can folks drop availability for a 30-min kickoff today or tomorrow?

Aisha (CSM): I'm available today 3-4pm PT or tomorrow 10-11am PT. I'll own weekly health check cadence.

Marco (Solutions Eng): I can do tomorrow 10am PT. Need to confirm Novus infra details (VPC, NAT, IP allowlist) before we schedule integration work.

Sam - Novus (Customer): Thanks — 10am tomorrow works for me. Quick heads up: our infra team is on EST and prefers afternoon.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Noted. @Sam — can you share point of contact for infra? Also listing initial success criteria so we can align: 1) API integration + basic generation in sandbox, 2) 95th pct latency < 300ms for 512 tokens in dedicated env, 3) acceptance tests pass on 10k sample prompts, 4) enablement session + docs for product team. Any additions?

Maya (Renewals): Add "baseline usage metric" for renewal trigger — target MAU and consistency of requests (we want to avoid bursty usage that looks healthy but isn't). Also flagging potential renewal risk: Novus mentioned an internal cost review next quarter.

Aisha (CSM): Good call. I'll put together a 30/60/90 health plan and include baseline MAU target and a renewal watch flag.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist: API key provisioned, test model pinned (we recommend redwood/llama-100b-quant for pilot), sample payloads, and a lightweight load test plan. Sample curl to sanity check once key is issued:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Thanks. @calendar-bot can you create a 30-min kickoff for tomorrow at 1:30pm ET / 10:30am PT with the agenda: intros, success criteria, infra checklist, milestones, action owners? :calendar:

calendar-bot: Created event "Novus Retail — Onboard Kickoff" for 2026-04-14 13:30 ET. Invitees: Priya, Aisha, Marco, Sam, Liam, Maya.

Liam (Enablement): I'll prepare an enablement pack: quickstart walkthrough, sample prompts, troubleshooting doc, and a 45-min training we can record. Suggest we schedule training for day 7 after integration.

Sam - Novus (Customer): That cadence sounds good. For acceptance tests, we have a labeled set of ~12k retail prompts. I'll share S3 link prior to kickoff.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Perfect. Action items so far:
- Sam: share infra POC and S3 link for prompts (due before kickoff)
- Marco: prepare tech checklist and load test template (due 1 day post-kickoff)
- Aisha: draft 30/60/90 health plan and MAU targets (due 3 days)
- Liam: enablement pack + recording (ready by day 7)
- Maya: set renewal_watch tag and note cost-review window in CRM

Aisha (CSM): I'll also add a quick retention/usage pulse survey to capture early feedback at day 14.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): One more risk: if Novus requires private deployment (on-prem/VPC) it may add 3-4 weeks. @Sam can you confirm preference?

Sam - Novus (Customer): We prefer VPC peering but can start in hosted sandbox and evaluate. We'll confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Maya (Renewals): Flagging that preference — increases renewal risk if we need private early. I'll mark as medium risk for now.

Marco (Solutions Eng): If we need VPC, we'll schedule infra sync right after kickoff. For sandbox -> private migration we have a migration runbook.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Great. I'll lead kickoff and share notes/owners after the meeting. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Aisha (CSM): thanks — looking forward to it.

Liam (Enablement): +1, will bring the enablement roadmap.

Sam - Novus (Customer): See you tomorrow.
